title.narrative: UNICEF also continued to serve as the Outcome Lead for the largest outcome on equitable and resilient social services under the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF), facilitating joint UN action on high-impact priorities.; Towards the latter part of 2024, the Sri Lanka Country Office (SLCO) conducted an extensive review and planning exercise at provincial and national levels with government and non-government implementing partners and stakeholders to reflect on the implementation of the two-year workplan (2023-2024), specifically the key achievements, challenges, and lessons learned, as well as identify the priorities for 2025.
